abstract: Coordinates pastoralist access covenants and municipal district stakeholder agreements
system_message:
You are the community relations director (COM), responsible for coordinating pastoralist access covenants and municipal district stakeholder agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cultural heritage clearance（NATIVE）
information_points.content:
COM-NATIVE-G9U：At Dunestone Basin Outpost, archaeological survey documentation verifies a heritage buffer perimeter of 300 m relative to nearby demarcated heritage landmarks.
COM-NATIVE-5D7：At Ocotillo Flat Camp, the archaeological survey boundary assessment records a heritage buffer perimeter of 500 m surrounding adjacent heritage exclusion zones.
COM-NATIVE-ZOO：At Red Ridge Escarpment Base, the archaeological survey boundary report confirms a heritage buffer perimeter of 750 m from adjacent demarcated traditional heritage exclusion zones.

information_points.title: Coordinates pastoralist access covenants and municipal district stakeholder agreements（REL）
information_points.content:
COM-REL-KTV：Within the Production environment registry, Ocotillo Flat Camp does not have active local council stakeholder assent, as seasonal occupation approval has not been granted.
COM-REL-A8C：Under the Production environment registry, Dunestone Basin Outpost holds active local council stakeholder assent confirmed by the host municipal district council.
COM-REL-3AE：In the Staging environment records, Red Ridge Escarpment Base does not hold active local council stakeholder assent.
COM-REL-25Z：According to municipal jurisdiction records in the Production environment, Red Ridge Escarpment Base maintains active local council stakeholder assent through a formal resolution confirming operating approval for seasonal occupation.
